archetypes.name: compat-shims
archetypes.rationale: Embedded plan-review shell assets were re-encoded and should be checked against their decoded behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the decoded plan-review compatibility assets in python/plan_review.py. Confirm every embedded legacy script that used the retired validator now resolves python/cli.py correctly from its temporary materialization root and preserves prior exit-code behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
